bibl.title: Archaeological Evidence of Land Tenure in the Petra Region, Jordan: Nabataean-Early Roman to Late Byzantine.
bibl.seg: Paula Kouki, Archaeological Evidence of Land Tenure in the Petra Region, Jordan: Nabataean-Early Roman to Late Byzantine.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Background. - The Petra papyri. - The archaeological evidence. - Settlement trends in the archaeological data. - Archaeological evidence of agricultural practices. - Rural settlement and land ownership in the Nabataean-Roman period. - Rural settlement and landownership in the Byzantine period. - Discussion and conclusion.
